subject: PCA function erroring out while using it with RHIPE

messages.author: 2569fd2cad12d66b
messages.subject: PCA function erroring out while using it with RHIPE
parts:
Hi ,

I am trying to apply PCA funtion for dataset in reducer and it is
erroring out with following message (Error in eval({ : could not find
function "PCA").

code:-

#! /usr/bin/env Rscript
library(Rhipe)
rhinit(TRUE,TRUE)
library(FactoMineR)

map<-expression({
extractPCAIPut = function(line){
fields <- unlist(strsplit(line, "\\,"))
valueline<-paste(line,",","\n")
print(fields[1])
rhcollect(fields[1],valueline)
}
lapply(map.values, extractPCAIPut)
})
reduce<-expression(
pre = {
delays <- numeric(0)
},
reduce = {
line <- c(line,reduce.values)
},
post={
#print(line)
line<-unlist(strsplit(paste(reduce.values), "\n"))
countline<-length(line)
word<-unlist(strsplit(line[1],","))
col<-length(word)
clustermat<-matrix(0, nrow = countline, ncol = col-1)
colval<-NULL
for(i in 1:length(line)){
words<-NULL
words<-unlist(strsplit(line[i],","))
colval<-NULL
wordlen<-length(words)-1
for(j in 1:wordlen){
colval<-cbind(colval,as.numeric(words[j]))
}
clustermat[i,]=colval
}
clustmatdf= data.frame(clustermat)
out<-PCA(input) rhcollect(reduce.key,out)
}
)

inputPath<-"/PCAIO"
outputPath<-"/PCAOUT"

ab <- rhmr(map=map,reduce=reduce,
ifolder=inputPath,ofolder=outputPath,
inout=c('text','text'),jobname="PCA",
mapred=list(mapred.reduce.tasks=2))
rhex(ab)


results <- rhread(paste(outputPath, "/part-*", sep = ""), type =
"text")
write(results, file="pcaOut.dat")

Error message:-

R ERROR BEGIN (reduce):
=============

Error in eval({ : could not find function "PCA"

R ERROR END
===========

at org.godhuli.rhipe.RHMRHelper
$MRErrorThread.run(RHMRHelper.java:391)

at
org.godhuli.rhipe.RHMRHelper.checkOuterrThreadsThrowable(RHMRHelper.java:
236)
at org.godhuli.rhipe.RHMRReducer.run(RHMRReducer.java:68)
at
org.apache.hadoop.mapred.ReduceTask.runNewReducer(ReduceTask.java:566)
at org.apache.hadoop.mapred.ReduceTask.run(ReduceTask.java:
408)
at org.apache.hadoop.mapred.Child.main(Child.java:170)

can any one please help in fixing the issue.

Thanks in advance

messages.author: 5b0c9158bfa781ba
messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] PCA function erroring out while using it with RHIPE
parts:
you have to call library(FactoMineR) some where in the setup sections or even the map or reduce sections (reduce$pre)
and for that to work, you need FactoMineR installed.
also i recommend with many packages to wrap the call to library with suppressMessages

messages.subject: Re: PCA function erroring out while using it with RHIPE
parts:
I have installed FactoMineR and related dependent packages for that. i
used library(FactoMineR)reducer but FactoMineR is not loading its
dependent package lattice and it has some version compatibility
issues, it supports only R 2.14 and i am using R 2.13. Let me upgrade
the R version and check if it is working or not. I need a help can we
get lattice package for R 2.13.

Thanks
Sandeep
